d: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband has called for tougher sanctions against Russia, telling MPs that “the more sanctions, the better” when it comes to weakening the Russian war machine. Appearing before the Foreign Affairs Select Committee in London, Miliband also declined to comment on Donald Trump referring to Vladimir Putin as “my friend” during their APEC Summit meeting. He warned of Russia’s intentions following an MI5 alert about alleged sabotage attempts targeting European defence-related facilities, including firms supplying Ukraine.
